metadata.name: confidential_batcher
metadata.description: Confidential batcher: aggregates encrypted deposits and reveals only each batch's total to a public share-mint vault

docs: Anchor entrypoint module for the confidential batcher.

instructions.name: cancel_dispatch
docs: Cancels a dispatched burn when settlement cannot complete. The join mint's wrapper
authority authorizes the operation. The burned total is restored to the batch token account
and encrypted total supply, and the batch becomes refund-only so users can retrieve their
recorded joins through `quit`.
Deny records: `(token, join mint)`.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Claims a user's confidential payout from a settled batch: one MulDiv
batch — the exact proportional floor
`encrypted(joined) x payout_received / total_joined` — then a
confidential transfer of the resulting handle to the user's payout
account. Permissionless pull — anyone can trigger a user's claim.
Deny records: `(batcher, batch)`, then `(token, payout mint)`.

instructions.name: dispatch
docs: Dispatches the batch once it is old enough: burns the batch account's
full encrypted balance via `confidential_burn_from_value` and records
the created-public burned handle the KMS will certify. Permissionless.
Deny records: `(token, join mint)`.

instructions.name: initialize_batcher
docs: Creates a batcher config for one direction, wiring a join confidential
mint, a payout confidential mint, and one public vault together.
Deposit batchers join with confidential underlying and pay confidential
shares; redeem batchers join with confidential shares and pay
confidential underlying. Permissionless one-time setup; the batcher
holds no admin role afterwards.

instructions.name: join
docs: Joins the pending batch with the batcher's join token: one user-signed
transaction that CPIs the coprocessor-attested confidential transfer
into the batch's token account. The token returns the transferred handle and grants
the JoinRecord Store access through transient store. The batcher adds it to the user's
contribution slot (decryptable by the user). Repeated joins accumulate.
Deny records: `(token, join mint)`, then `(batcher, batch)`.

instructions.name: open_batch
docs: Opens the next batch: creates the `Batch` account, its per-batch
authority PDA, its own confidential join and payout token accounts
unless they already exist, and its plain SPL accounts for settle's
phases. Permissionless; requires
the previous batch of the same batcher to have been dispatched (a
batcher's batches never overlap while pending; the other direction's
batcher is independent). `authority_funding_lamports` is moved from
the payer to the batch authority PDA, which pays the rent the token
CPIs charge to the account owner. Unspent funding stays on the PDA until
the batch is finished and `reclaim_batch_authority` returns it.
Deny records: `(token, join mint)`, then `(token, payout mint)`.

instructions.name: quit
docs: Leaves a pending batch before dispatch, or a refunding batch after dispatch cancellation:
transfers the user's exact
recorded amount back from the batch account (all-or-nothing) and
resets the joined encrypted store to zero.
Deny records: `(token, join mint)` and `(batcher, batch)` for the refund, then
`(batcher, batch)` again for the reset.

instructions.name: reclaim_batch_authority
docs: Returns a finished batch's (settled, canceled or refunding) unspent
authority funding to the join mint's wrapper authority, the operator
role that funds batches. Claims and quits pay their own rent, so the
authority needs no lamports after this point.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Settles a dispatched batch with the KMS certificate for its burned
total: redeems the plain tokens, moves them through the vault
(deposit for deposit batchers, withdraw for redeem batchers), wraps
the received payout into confidential payout tokens, and records the
batch's informational public rate. A zero-total batch is canceled
instead. Permissionless.
Deny records: `(token, payout mint)`, or none for a zero total, which runs no execution.

docs: Pays the batch authority funding. Anyone.

accounts.name: batcher

accounts.name: batch

accounts.name: batch_authority
docs: depositor/withdrawer, and wrap owner via invoke_signed. Receives
funding for the rent the wrap execution (and any other owner-charged CPIs)
charge to the owner; redemption closes the already-open pending burn.

types.name: ConfidentialMint
docs: Confidential mint state for the token PoC.
The total supply's current handle and access encrypted store live in the
`EncryptedStore` account at `total_supply_encrypted_store`.

fields.name: authority
docs: Admin/authority that created the mint.

fields.name: underlying_mint
docs: Underlying SPL mint wrapped by this confidential mint.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Decimal precision inherited from the underlying mint.

types.name: CoprocessorInputAttestation
docs: A coprocessor input attestation carried inline by a [`FheExecuteOperand::VerifiedInput`], re-verified
in-execution (no account, no PDA) — the instruction-local analog of EVM `allowTransient(input, contract)`.

fields.name: input_handle
docs: The verified input handle used as the operand.

fields.name: ct_handles
docs: All ciphertext handles covered by the proof.

fields.name: handle_index
docs: Index of `input_handle` within `ct_handles`.

fields.name: user_address
docs: Attested user identity (bytes32).

fields.name: contract_address
docs: Attested contract identity — the application program the input is bound to (bytes32).

fields.name: contract_chain_id
docs: Host chain id the attestation binds (EVM `contractChainId`); the gateway chain id only
enters through the EIP-712 domain.

fields.name: extra_data
docs: Opaque extra data covered by the attestation.

fields.name: signatures
docs: Coprocessor EIP-712 signatures (65-byte secp256k1).

types.name: HostConfig
docs: Singleton host configuration and authority surface.
`HostConfig` is the runtime switchboard for this PoC. Each paused area rejects the
instructions it covers (`PauseFlags`).

fields.name: admin
docs: Program administrator allowed to update config flags.

fields.name: chain_id
docs: Host-chain id included in handle derivation.

fields.name: gateway_chain_id
docs: EVM gateway chain id used in the coprocessor/KMS EIP-712 domain separators.

fields.name: input_verification_contract
docs: EVM `InputVerification` contract address: the EIP-712 verifying contract for
coprocessor `CiphertextVerification` input attestations.

fields.name: coprocessor_signers
docs: Registered coprocessor EVM signer set for input attestations (EVM `InputVerifier`
parity). Fixed-capacity so `HostConfig` keeps a pinned byte layout; only the first
`coprocessor_signer_count` entries are active, the rest are zero padding.

fields.name: coprocessor_signer_count
docs: Number of active entries in `coprocessor_signers`.

fields.name: coprocessor_threshold
docs: Minimum distinct valid signatures (n-of-m) required over an input attestation;
`1 <= coprocessor_threshold <= coprocessor_signer_count`.

fields.name: decryption_contract
docs: EVM `Decryption` contract address: the EIP-712 verifying contract for KMS
`PublicDecryptVerification` certificates (disclose/redeem).

fields.name: current_kms_context_id
docs: Active KMS context id (mirrors `ProtocolConfig.getCurrentKmsContextId`). The
signer set + thresholds live in the `KmsContext` PDA at this id; `[0; 32]` means
none defined yet. Updated by `define_kms_context`.

fields.name: current_kms_epoch_id
docs: Active KMS epoch id of the active context (with the context, mirrors
`ProtocolConfig.getCurrentKmsContextAndEpoch`); `[0; 32]` until the first context. Updated
by `define_kms_context` and `define_kms_epoch`. Certificate verification reads only the context.

fields.name: paused
docs: Host areas currently stopped. A pauser sets them; only the admin clears them (DD-058).

fields.name: grant_deny_list_enabled
docs: Enables the deny list: a denied application `(program, scope)` cannot compute, allow, or make a handle public.

fields.name: max_hcu_per_tx
docs: Max total HCU summed over every execution in one transaction. `u64::MAX` = unlimited
(enforcement off); `0` is rejected at set time.

fields.name: max_hcu_depth_per_tx
docs: Max critical-path (depth) HCU across every execution in one transaction. `u64::MAX` =
unlimited; `0` is rejected at set time.

fields.name: hcu_block_cap_per_app
docs: Per-app HCU budget per slot, enforced in `fhe_execute`. `u64::MAX` = unrestricted (the ship
default; short-circuits, touching no meter); `0` = ban untrusted apps (trusted still
bypass) — the one knob where `0` is a real semantic; any other value is the metering band
(must be `>= max_hcu_per_tx` unless that is unlimited).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for `PDA("host-config")`.

types.name: JoinRecord
docs: Per-(batch, user) join record. The encrypted amount itself lives in the batcher-owned
`EncryptedStore` account at `joined_encrypted_store`: the user may decrypt their pending
amount, and the batch authority computes refunds and claims from it by signature.

fields.name: batch
docs: Batch this record belongs to.

fields.name: user
docs: Joining user.

fields.name: claimed
docs: Whether the user's payout was claimed.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for `(batch, user)`.

types.name: JoinRecordClosed
docs: Emitted when a user closes their spent join record.

fields.name: version
docs: Event schema version.

fields.name: batch
docs: Batch account.

fields.name: user
docs: User whose record was closed; received its rent.

types.name: JoinedBatch
docs: Emitted when a user joins a batch. The amount stays encrypted; only the
participation is public (by design — see CONFIDENTIAL_VAULTS.md).

fields.name: version
docs: Event schema version.

fields.name: batch
docs: Batch account.

fields.name: user
docs: Joining user.

fields.name: joined_encrypted_store
docs: `EncryptedStore` encrypted store holding the user's accumulated joined amount.

fields.name: joined_handle
docs: Current handle of the joined encrypted store after this join.

types.name: PauseFlags
docs: The host areas a pauser can stop, each matching an area EVM pauses on its own (DD-058). As
the argument of `pause` and `unpause`, a set field names an area to change.

fields.name: execution
docs: `fhe_execute`, with the allows, transient grants and public releases it writes (EVM ACL
pause, which stops execution through `allowTransient`).

fields.name: verified_inputs
docs: `fhe_execute` steps that consume a coprocessor-attested input (no EVM counterpart:
`InputVerifier` cannot be paused, DD-058).

fields.name: acl_writes
docs: ACL writes outside an execution: Store creation, `make_store_handle_public` and
user-decryption delegation (EVM ACL pause).

types.name: PayoutClaimed
docs: Emitted when a user's confidential payout is claimed from a settled batch.

fields.name: version
docs: Event schema version.

fields.name: batch
docs: Batch account.

fields.name: user
docs: User the payout was transferred to.

fields.name: claim_store
docs: `EncryptedStore` encrypted store holding the claimed payout amount.

fields.name: claim_handle
docs: Calculated entitlement, distinct from the token transfer event's paid handle.

types.name: QuitBatch
docs: Emitted when a user quits a pending batch: the exact recorded amount was
transferred back and the joined encrypted store reset to zero.

fields.name: version
docs: Event schema version.

fields.name: batch
docs: Batch account.

fields.name: user
docs: Quitting user.

types.name: Vault
docs: Public share-mint vault state.
Deliberately minimal: totals are never mirrored here. Total assets are read
live from the vault token account balance and total shares from the share
mint supply, so a permissionless `harvest` (a plain donation transfer) is
accounted for by construction — the donation just increases the token
account balance, and every share-price read picks it up.

fields.name: underlying_mint
docs: Underlying token mint the vault accepts.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: Share mint issued 1:1 in decimals with the underlying.

fields.name: vault_token_account
docs: Token account holding the vault's underlying assets, owned by the authority PDA.

fields.name: authority_bump
docs: Bump for the vault authority PDA that owns assets and the share mint.

constants.name: JOINED_AMOUNT_KEY
docs: Join-store key of the user's encrypted joined amount.
